(A mage gazing into the dark sky senses an unusual presence. Though he cannot see, he turns toward it and steps forward.)
strings.(사이암이 누군가 자신의 손을 붙잡자 짐짓 놀란다. 작은 손에서 느껴지는: (Siam starts slightly as someone takes his hand. Recognizing the warmth of that small hand, he speaks a name he has missed.)
Hello, Siam... It's been a long time.
strings.진정 이리스 양인게요?: Is it truly you, Miss Iris?
strings.(사이암이 이리스의 대답에 그만 지팡이를 놓쳐버린다. 이리스가 지팡이를: (At Iris' reply, Siam drops his staff. As she picks it up and hands it back, the emotions she has been holding in suddenly spill over.)
strings.이리스 양, 내게 미안하다고, 내가 불쌍하다고 생각하지 마시오. 이건 온: Miss Iris, do not apologize to me or pity me. This was entirely my own choice...
strings.울지 마시오. 그대가 운다면 당신을 믿고 있는 모두의 맘에 비가 내릴테니: Do not cry. Your tears would bring rain to the hearts of everyone who believes in you... So...
strings.(이리스가 흐르던 눈물을 닦고 배시시 웃는다.): (Iris wipes away her tears and gives a small smile.)
strings.이리스 양이 해준 말이 생각났다오. 그대의 할머니께서 이렇게 하면 울음이: I remembered what you told me. Your grandmother used to say that to make the tears go away.
Do not forget that I am a mage whose excellent memory once let him learn countless spells at once. Hehe.
strings.그런데 이곳은 어떻게 온 것이오? 이곳은 이리스 양이 닿을 수 없는 공간: But how did you come here? This should have been a place beyond your reach...
strings.오랫동안 이곳을 위협했던 '그'가 사라졌어요. 많은 분들의 도움이 있었거: 'He,' who threatened this place for so long, is gone. Many people helped us.
Ah, Azrael... It saddens me a little to think I cannot return...
strings.사이암, 비록 바이스의 아즈라엘은 사라졌지만…, 사이암의 아즈라엘은 그대: Siam, Weiss' Azrael may be gone... But your Azrael still exists.
strings.시공간의 흐름이 뒤틀린 이곳에서 지내면서 난 에트와르에 여러 개의 시간이: Living here, where the flow of time and space is distorted, I learned that Etoile has multiple timelines.
But I did not know Azrael had multiple timelines as well.
strings.그래서 내가 알고 있던 영웅이 아즈라엘을 지키고자 스스로 악이 됐다는 걸: That is why I could not understand how the hero I knew had chosen to become evil to protect Azrael...
strings.미안하오, 우리 세계의 존재가 이곳을 어지럽혔소. 비록 난 그의 세계에: I am sorry. A being from our world brought chaos to yours. Though I did not belong to his world...
strings.사이암이 했던 말처럼, 제게 미안해하지 마세요. 그건 사이암이 한 일이: As you told me, Siam, don't apologize. You weren't responsible.
strings.그러면 나중에 기회가 된다면 아즈라엘의 주민으로서 에트와르를 위해 할 수: Then, if the opportunity comes, I would like to do what I can for Etoile as a resident of Azrael. Will you permit it?
strings.아니요, 이리스 양, 내가 더 고맙소. 앞으로도 종종 놀러와서 말벗을 해: No, Miss Iris. I am the one who is grateful. Come visit and keep me company from time to time. Oh, Miss Iris?
strings.(이리스가 사이암의 손을 잡아 당긴다.): (Iris gently pulls Siam by the hand.)
I'll let you feel a new light, Siam.
Everyone is waiting for you to return.
strings.(아무도 없는 수레바퀴 안, 푸른 비늘을 가진 거대한 드래곤이 눈을 감은: (Inside the otherwise empty wheel, a vast blue-scaled dragon sits with his eyes closed.)
strings.(아드키나가 눈을 뜨자 자신을 사랑스럽게 바라보는 한 존재와 눈이 마주친: (Atkina opens his eyes and meets the gaze of a being looking at him with love.)
strings.네, 그곳에 잠깐 다녀왔어요. 바이스로 인해 많은 시간이 흔들려서 그곳을: Yes, I visited briefly. Weiss disturbed so many timelines that I had to check on that place...
As always, time seems to flow differently there.
It is a place where it must.
strings.(아드키나 또한 가이아의 눈빛이 무엇을 의미하는지 아는 것처럼 조용히 고: (As though understanding her gaze, Atkina quietly lowers his head toward her. Gaia gently strokes his face.)
Atkina, I've come to say goodbye.
I'm sorry. I wanted to stay in this land longer this time...
strings.아무것도 할 수 없던 저를 이끌어주고 지탱해준 아드키나, 당신에게 늘 고: You guided and supported me when I could do nothing. I am always grateful to you, Atkina.
strings.새로운 별의 주인이 된 이리스에게도…. 이리스와 함께 해주는 %s에게도…: And to Iris, the new ruler of this star... And to %s, who stands beside her...
strings.그리고 당신과 함께 한 발드릭, 지스카드, 샤이닉, 이오, 메디아에게도…: And to Valdrick, Ziskad, Shynic, Io, and Medea, who stood with you...
strings.비록 직접 만나 감사하다고 말을 하지 못하지만, 다음에 만난다면 제대로: I cannot meet them now to thank them in person, but I hope to do so properly next time.
I will tell them for you. You need not worry. But...
Does Lady Iris know? That you are going to Pneuma?
strings.제가 돌아왔으니 이리스도 알게 될 거에요. 하지만, 지금 이리스를 만날: Now that I have returned, Iris will know. But I cannot meet her now. My familiarity with that place may have a harmful effect... I must leave at once...
Yes. It is that sort of place.
Please give my regards to the Weaver... to that child in Pneuma, as well.
I will. And Atkina... Thank you...
strings.(가이아가 조용히 눈을 감자 수레바퀴 안으로 작은 나비가 한마리 날아온다: (Gaia quietly closes her eyes, and a small butterfly flies into the wheel.)
strings.(나비는 이내 주위를 맴돌더니 천천히 가이아를 어딘가로 데려간다.): (It circles nearby, then slowly leads Gaia away.)
I will wait until you return...
Even if you awaken in another form, I will recognize you first...
strings.(어둠 속에서 어떤 장소의 기억을 바라보고 있던 누군가의 쓸쓸한 목소리가: (In the darkness, a lonely voice rises from someone watching the memory of a place.)
strings.이번엔 자네의 운이 좋았네. 이리스 그 아이가 그런 식으로 운명을 바꿀: You were fortunate this time. To think that child Iris would change fate in such a way.
strings.내가 자네를 세레스와 만나게 해주겠다고 했었지? 그 약속을 지키지 못하게: I said I would reunite you with Seres, didn't I? How cruel of you to prevent me from keeping that promise.
strings.이번엔 조금 지켜보겠네. 자네들이 사랑했던 세계가 사라지길 바라는 이들이: I will watch for a while this time. There are others who wish to see the world you loved disappear.
That is a lengthy conversation with yourself.
strings.하하, 그대도 나를 위약자라 부를 것인가?: Haha. Will you call me Oathbreaker too?
Shortly before you, a creation of the architect who departed for another world fell here. It displeased me, but all is well now.
Come to think of it, you are not a complete being.
Why did you answer my call? You could have ignored it and passed on.
strings.죄인이 바랐던 '구원'을 그대도 추구하는 걸 알고 있네. 그래서 확인차: I know you also seek the 'salvation' the sinner desired. I called to confirm it. Everything rests on creation and will as you understand them...
Yes. There was something I wished to confirm. You may return at once.
Ah, the road to the 'salvation' you seek will be far from easy.
strings.아직 그 땅엔 그대 말고도 이질적인 존재들이 많지. 악마와 마족, 여신의: That land still holds many beings that do not belong, besides you. Devils and demons, the goddess' people, sinners who escaped their fate...
And those who await the night...
strings.당신을 만나는 건 이번 뿐입니다. 그리고 모든 게 끝날 때까지 만나지 않: This is the only time I will meet you. And I hope we do not meet again until everything is over.
strings.자네도 모든 것이 길지 않나, 하하하. 그러면 그대가 있던 곳으로 보내주: Your own story is hardly short, hahaha. Very well. I will send you back.
strings.(노인의 주위에서 말을 섞었던 존재가 사라지자, 노인이 천천히 어둠 속에: (When the being speaking with him vanishes, the old man slowly turns his gaze elsewhere in the darkness.)
Merely someone's creation, yet it refuses to show its hand.
Then I shall look forward to the new day... the new night to come.
Emissary of the goddess, watching this: you may open your eyes now.
